place.description: The placement location, such as 'Content:1', a zone and position, or '-' to hide the shape.

displayType.description: The display type the placement applies to, such as Detail, Summary or Edit. Leave it empty to apply to every display type.

differentiator.description: The differentiator that narrows the placement to a specific named shape, such as a specific field name.

shape.description: The shape type the placement renders instead of the default shape.

alternates.description: The alternates added to the shape so a template can override its rendering.

wrappers.description: The wrapper shapes rendered around the shape.

oneOf.description: A single content part name to match, such as BodyPart.
A set of content part names, any of which matches.

contentPart.description: Applies the placement only when the content item has a matching content part. Accepts a single content part or an array of content parts.

oneOf.description: A single content type or stereotype to match, such as Article or Widget*.
A set of content types or stereotypes, any of which matches.

contentType.description: Applies the placement only when the shape belongs to a matching content type or stereotype. A trailing '*' matches by prefix. Accepts a single content type or an array of content types.

oneOf.description: A single request path to match, such as /about or ~/blog/*.
A set of request paths, any of which matches.

path.description: Applies the placement only when the current request path matches. A trailing '*' matches by prefix. Accepts a single path or an array of paths.

items.description: A placement node describing where and how a shape is rendered, optionally narrowed by filters.

Placements.description: A dictionary keyed by shape type. Each value is an array of placement nodes applied to that shape.
